findings.current: He was startled once by the fifty mounted riders and the intimidating presence of the escort, then twice more when he recognized Hyuk Mujin and me.
findings.defect: “Twice more” makes him react three times in total. The Korean counts the first shock and then a second shock.
findings.rationale: 한 번 놀라고 … 두 번 놀랐다 means he was startled once and then for the second time, not two additional times.
findings.replacement: He was startled once by the fifty mounted riders and the intimidating presence of the escort, then a second time when he recognized Hyuk Mujin and me.
findings.source: 녀석은 오십 기의 기마, 호위대의 위압감에 한 번 놀라고 나와 혁무진을 보고 두 번 놀랐다.

findings.current: “The private room is fifty nyang of silver for one night. That’s right, isn’t it?”
findings.defect: 별채 is a separate annex or detached lodging, not merely a private room.
findings.rationale: The current wording changes the type and scale of accommodation being rented.
findings.replacement: “The private annex is fifty nyang of silver for one night. That’s right, isn’t it?”

findings.current: The City Lord is the one who governs each city under the Emperor’s command, so he possesses considerable power and authority.
findings.defect: The translation changes 각 성 from the provinces to cities, substantially understating the City Lord’s jurisdiction.
findings.rationale: Here 성 refers to a province, as confirmed by Shanxi Province and the explanation of the City Lord’s extensive authority.
findings.replacement: The City Lords govern their respective provinces under the Emperor’s command, so they possess considerable power and authority.
findings.source: 바로 그 황제의 명을 받들어 각 성을 다스리는 자가 성주이니 상당한 힘과 권한이 있지.

findings.current: “Second Young Master, our family has not yet become one of the Nine Sects or Ten Great Families. Please refrain from saying things that could cause trouble.”
findings.defect: The draft mistranslates both named Murim groupings: 구파일방 is the Nine Sects and One Gang, while 오대세가 is the Five Great Families, not Ten Great Families.
findings.rationale: The current version changes the identities and quantities of two major institutional groupings invoked to explain the Jin Family’s limited standing.
findings.replacement: “Second Young Master, our family does not yet stand alongside the Nine Sects and One Gang or the Five Great Families. Please refrain from saying anything that could cause trouble.”
findings.source: “이공자, 본 가는 아직 구파일방도, 오대세가도 되지 못합니다. 자칫 문제가 생길 말은 삼가십시오.”

findings.current: But the mounted bandits killed and burned people indiscriminately, didn’t they?
findings.defect: The draft makes people the explicit object of both killing and burning, whereas the Korean leaves the object of 불태우다 unstated and broadly describes indiscriminate killing and arson.
findings.rationale: 닥치는 대로 modifies the bandits’ indiscriminate destruction without specifically stating that they burn people alive.
findings.replacement: But the mounted bandits killed indiscriminately and burned everything in their path, didn’t they?
findings.source: 하지만 마적 놈들은 그런 거 없이 닥치는 대로 죽이고 불태우는 놈들 아닌가?

findings.current: There are rumors that the current Emperor assassinated the Crown Prince, his own older brother, before ascending the throne.
findings.defect: The draft omits 바로 위의, which identifies the Crown Prince as the Emperor’s immediately older brother rather than merely any older brother.
findings.rationale: The source gives a specific sibling-order relationship that the current translation flattens.
findings.replacement: There are rumors that the current Emperor assassinated the Crown Prince, the brother immediately older than him, before ascending the throne.
findings.source: 현 황제도 바로 위의 형인 태자를 암살하고 황위에 올랐다는 소문이 도니까.

findings.current: “Then how can someone who’s practically a king be so incompetent? If he writes his brother a single letter, he could get all the support he needs from the capital. Are they on bad terms?”
findings.defect: “From the capital” adds a location absent from the Korean. 위에서 refers generally to support from above or the higher authorities.
findings.rationale: The source specifies the direction of authority, not where the assistance would physically originate.
findings.replacement: “Then how can someone who’s practically a king be so incompetent? If he writes his brother a single letter, he could get all the support he needs from above. Are they on bad terms?”
findings.source: “그런데 왕씩이나 되는 양반이 왜 그렇게 무능해? 형한테 편지 한 통 쓰면 위에서 지원 빵빵하게 해 주겠구먼. 둘이 사이 안 좋나?”

findings.defect: The generic acknowledgment loses the formal subordinate register of 존명, an explicit declaration that the order will be obeyed.
findings.rationale: 존명 is a deferential acceptance of an order, fitting Hyuk Mujin’s response to the Lesser Family Head.

findings.current: “Treason is punishable by at least the punishment of three clans. Congratulations, little brother.”
findings.defect: “Punishable by at least the punishment” is an unnatural and redundant English construction.
findings.rationale: The replacement naturally preserves the stated minimum scope of collective punishment and Jin Mukyung’s deadpan taunt.
findings.replacement: “Treason gets at least three clans punished. Congratulations, little brother.”
findings.source: “역모죄는 최소 삼족(三族)이 처벌받지. 축하한다, 아우야.”

findings.current: You have accepted the **[The City Lord’s Invitation]** Quest!
findings.defect: The System notice retains square brackets around the Quest title, contrary to the required System-panel formatting.
findings.rationale: The framed System window already identifies this as UI content, so the source brackets should not be reproduced.
findings.replacement: You have accepted the **The City Lord’s Invitation** Quest!

summary: Several factual and structural errors alter quantities, lodging type, governmental jurisdiction, institutional hierarchy, and kinship; the System panels also violate the required Markdown format.
